verdict.rationale: Helicone exposes a documented public REST API (query endpoints like /v1/request/query, confirmed via a live OpenAPI/swagger.json spec) plus an AI Gateway/OpenAI-compatible API, webhooks, and SDK integrations, all documented with concrete curl examples and endpoint references. Missing for 10: broader REST API reference coverage beyond a couple endpoints, independent third-party corroboration of API robustness, and detailed auth/rate-limit docs for the public API itself.
